result.note: Tested the June 2026 Modi-Trump G7 meeting outcomes and the expansion of the India-US COMPACT framework; skipped the tariff analysis and the brief Zelenskyy meeting.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the meeting between Prime Minister Modi and President Trump in June 2026:
items: It took place on the margins of the G7 Summit and was their first meeting since February 2025.
The two leaders instructed officials to finalise an interim Bilateral Trade Agreement.
US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer was to travel to India the following week to take the trade talks forward.
questions.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three are correct. The leaders asked officials to finalise the interim trade deal at the earliest, and Greer was to visit India the next week. The meeting marked a thaw after a year of strained ties, with India seeking relief from punitive tariffs on its exporters.
questions.source: with US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer travelling to India next week to take the talks forward

questions.prompt: The India-US COMPACT, reviewed by the two leaders in June 2026, is a framework agreed in Washington in February 2025. In this acronym, the letter 'M' stands for:
questions.explain: COMPACT stands for Catalyzing Opportunities for Military Partnership, Accelerated Commerce and Technology. It is the India-US defence and technology framework agreed in February 2025.
questions.source: India-US COMPACT (Catalyzing Opportunities for Military Partnership, Accelerated Commerce and Technology), the defence and technology framework agreed in Washington in February 2025.
